mcat_description.short: Prefabricated factory sheds are pre-engineered steel structures — comprising primary frames, secondary members, and roof/wall sheeting — factory-fabricated and bolted together on-site for industrial and manufacturing facilities. They are sold as complete turnkey structures or as supply-and-erect packages, quoted per square foot of covered area.
mcat_description.long: Prefabricated factory sheds in India are predominantly Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — steel-framed structures with tapered columns, rafters, purlins, and Galvalume/colour-coated roofing and wall cladding, designed to IS:800, IS:875, and IS:1893 codes for structural, wind, and seismic loads. The primary structural steel is IS:2062 mild steel, with roofing sheets in Galvalume at 0.47–0.60 mm thickness and yield strengths of 345–550 MPa. A secondary tier of simpler pipe/truss sheds with GI or tin sheet roofing (colloquially 'tin sheds') serves smaller SME buyers at lower cost. Buyers procure these as complete design-fabricate-supply-erect (DFSE) contracts, with spans ranging from 10 m to 100 m and eave heights from 20 ft to 45 ft, customised to machinery layout, crane requirements, and site conditions.

market_context: Prefabricated factory sheds in India are dominated by the Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) system — factory-fabricated steel structures assembled on-site with bolted connections, designed to IS:800 (steel structures), IS:875 (wind loads), and IS:1893 (seismic loads). The primary structural steel grade is IS:2062, with roofing and cladding in Galvalume sheets (0.47–0.60 mm, 345–550 MPa yield strength) or colour-coated GI sheets. A secondary lower-cost segment — colloquially called 'tin shed' or 'pipe shed' in Indian buyer vocabulary — uses MS pipe columns and conventional truss frames with GI/tin sheet roofing, popular with SME buyers. PEB sheds offer 30–40% faster construction versus conventional builds and are the preferred choice for warehouses, distribution centres, manufacturing sheds, and cold-storage facilities across India. Key Indian manufacturers include EPACK Prefab, Metal Tree, Kamdhenu PEB, Utkarsh India, Star PEB India, and Pressmach. Buyers typically procure as design-fabricate-supply-erect (DFSE) turnkey contracts, with spans from 10 m to 100 m and eave heights from 20 ft to 45 ft. Crane-compatible sheds (with EOT crane runway beams) and insulated PUF panel sheds for temperature-controlled environments are growing sub-segments. Manufacturing hubs driving demand include Pune, Bangalore, Faridabad, Chennai, and Gujarat industrial corridors.
